Research Philosophy

We think like sceptical
buy-side analysts.

ARI is not an AI summariser. It reads annual reports the way an experienced analyst does — looking for what changed, what management is obscuring, and where the market may be wrong.

Every output is evidence-linked. Every conclusion is challenged. The goal is one question: is this stock worth deeper work?

Business Quality

Pricing power, switching costs, competitive position

Financial Quality

Cash conversion, margin quality, leverage discipline

Management Quality

Execution track record, capital allocation, candour

Governance Intelligence

Board independence, remuneration alignment, disclosure

What Changed Engine

Year-on-year strategy, tone, and risk delta analysis

Variant Perception

What the market is missing or mispricing
